decisions.reason: Because this certified HVAC plate heat exchanger line is very close to the firm's established heat-exchange knowledge base, the firm can use its engineering, service feedback, and R&D capabilities to improve it rather than withdraw it.

Management would keep this marine box cooler system because it builds directly on existing marine cooling capabilities and already shows strong market acceptance through the reported major market share.

This marine cooling unit fits the firm's core application areas and installed-base service model, giving the firm enough related knowledge to learn from early market experience and refine it commercially.

Although early evidence is limited, the compact oil cooler is still close to the firm's existing exchanger portfolio, so a capable German machinery firm with in-house R&D would usually continue and optimize it rather than exit quickly.

The finned tube for air coolers extends the firm's established air-cooling and component know-how, making it a product the firm is well positioned to absorb, improve, and support within its broad portfolio.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes rely on core thermal-engineering knowledge and benefit from the firm's own R&D and cooperation experience, so management would be inclined to retain and develop them further.
